narrative.overview:
A conventional dark application. Both surfaces are one centred panel on a slate canvas. The wizard swaps its body and footer with the plan's state — capture, planning, clarify, review, approved, and a failure case — while the frame around it stays put: a slim top bar, a labelled step path, a thin progress bar, the goal, and a plain timeline of days. The plan index is one row per plan on the same kind of panel, divided by hairlines, each row carrying the plan's status, its dates, and how far along it is. There is no card deck, no metaphor, and nothing that needs a diagram to explain.

The first surface's palette is kept and re-cast. The slate ground #0e1a24 stops being a tabletop and becomes the canvas itself; panels rest on it as #16232e surfaces with #24343f hairlines; sheet #f2f4f0 becomes the primary text and steel-ghost #9fb2bd the muted tier. Hi-vis orange #ff5a1f survives as the single rationed accent — the one primary action, the focus ring, the active step, and the deadline — and ink #16222c is the text that sits on it. Archivo is kept at its normal width on one scale, in sentence case; the condensed cut is gone.

Depth is hairlines and tonal surfaces. There is no sheet shadow and no ornament: panels are separated from the canvas by a 1px line and a slightly lighter fill. Every rejection from the first world is honoured — no camps, no summit or turnaround, no route card, no elevation chart, no stamp, no punched tabs, no tracked uppercase labels — and the progress-dot stepper ban is deliberately lifted: this build states where the visitor is with a labelled step path and a progress bar, the ordinary way.
keyCharacteristics: One panel per surface, at most ~720px, centred on a slate canvas.
Three slate surface values (canvas / panel / elevated) plus one rationed hi-vis accent.
A single family, Archivo, at its normal width, on one scale, in sentence case.
Depth from a single hairline and a tonal step; no shadow anywhere.
Standard fields, three button weights, and pills only for badges and markers.
The plan index is hairline rows, not cards: status, dates, progress, one action.
Tabular figures everywhere a date, time, or count appears.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Hi-vis orange (#ff5a1f) is the only accent and it is rationed: the primary action, the focus ring, the active step, the deadline, and the progress bar. Nothing else may be orange. Its scarcity is what makes it read as signal.

rules.name: The Tinted-Muted Rule
rules.body: Muted text on the canvas is always steel-ghost (#9fb2bd), a light tint of the canvas's own hue. Neutral gray is never introduced, and steel-soft (#55707f) never carries body text.

rules.name: The Tonal-Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are three values of one slate: canvas, panel, elevated. There is no fourth, and no surface is coloured except a hi-vis or danger tint at 10% or less.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the only family, at its normal width. Emphasis comes from size and weight, never from a second face or the condensed cut.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set in uppercase with tracking — not labels, not buttons, not badges. The stencilled voice of the first world is retired.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every date, time, count, and duration uses tabular figures, so the deadline arithmetic reads cleanly down a column.

rules.name: The One Panel Rule
rules.body: Each surface is one panel. The flow's panel changes its body and footer; the index's panel is a list of hairline rows. Neither becomes multiple cards, a deck, or a wizard of separate pages.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the flow casts a shadow. Separation is a hairline and a tonal step. The only depth in the system is the field's focus ring.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every separator is exactly 1px of ground-line (#24343f). A heavier emphasis is a fill, not a thicker border.

rules.name: The Small-Radius Rule
rules.body: Fields and buttons are 6px, alerts 8px, the panel 12px. Nothing is square, and nothing is a capsule — pills are for badges and markers only.

rules.name: The No-Device Rule
rules.body: No clipped corners, folds, perforations, or punched ends. Shape never carries metaphor.

dos: Do keep hi-vis orange (#ff5a1f) to the primary action, the focus ring, the active step, the deadline, and the progress bar.
Do render the flow as one panel whose body and footer swap with the phase.
Do keep the plan index on one panel of hairline rows — status, description, dates, progress, one action — with the status filter in the URL.
Do set all copy in sentence case, in Archivo at normal width, on one scale.
Do state the deadline arithmetic plainly — timeline ticks, tabular dates, the count.
Do use tabular figures for every date, time, count, and duration.
Do express depth with hairlines and the two tonal steps; add no shadow.
Do make destructive actions arm before they fire, with the label naming the consequence.
donts: Don't reintroduce the metaphor or its devices — camps, summit, turnaround, route card, elevation profile, stamp, punched tabs.
Don't use a second accent, orange chrome, gradients, glass, or glow.
Don't set labels or buttons in uppercase with tracking, or use the condensed cut.
Don't gray muted text — tint it from the canvas (steel-ghost) instead.
Don't fabricate progress charts, points, or streaks for effect; the only chart is the real timeline.
Don't add shadows to more elements; the system has none.
